# Bugbug

Bugbug is a low-code test automation tool. The easiest way to cut costs of software testing.

Automate your web app testing 3x faster without scaling your QA team.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bugbug/.

## Actions

- **Get test run details** (read-only): Get detailed information about test runs from bugbug.
- **List suites** (read-only): List all available test suites in the bugbug platform.
- **List tests** (read-only): Retrieves a list of all available tests in the bugbug account.
- **Run test**: Execute a test in bugbug and return the test run details.
